row.notes: Large end-of-session stat handler: MaximumResourcesPointsInAPracticeSession, SetWinsInCurrentSeason, PodiumsAchieved, BeatTeamMate, FlashbacksUsedInSession, RaceSpectated, AchieveExpectedFinishingPosition, CompleteRankedRaceInElite, BeatOtherPlayerAfterQualifyingBehind; dispatches WriteGotPodiumFinish[V2/V3], OneTwoFinish, FinishedRaceWithCustomWeather/TOD, FinishedHardcoreRace, AssistsDisabled, DriveThroughAndWinRace, RankedMatches, SetFastestLapInSession.
